釈迦如来.reason: Passage and tip falsely say shaved heads distinguish Buddhas; Buddha images commonly have curls/usnisha. Replace with verified Seiryoji transmission and explicit distinction of devotional likeness from portrait evidence.

無常.reason: Original denies any permanence outside the flow of arising and ceasing, overextending conditioned impermanence and erasing the unconditioned distinction. Restrict explanation to conditioned phenomena.

法話.reason: Original creates an unsupported categorical contrast in which 説教 only teaches precepts and 法話 only relates doctrine to daily scenes. Explain actual overlapping usage without invented event or definition.

曼荼羅.reason: Original reduces mandalas to physically entered ritual spaces and denies their pictorial role. Describe diverse diagrammatic, spatial and ritual forms without universal physical-entry claims.

不二一元.reason: Original claims renunciants as a class choose one daily practice and presents an unsupported uniform curriculum. Replace with clearly attributed Advaita doctrine and no invented practitioner behavior.

無明.reason: Original says experiments can measure only selective-attention limits, falsely restricting cognitive research. Explain doctrinal ignorance without unsupported scientific comparison.

真言.reason: Original restricts mantra to Chinese phonetic writing and asserts meaning is irrelevant. Explain sacred utterance, inherited sound and practice without universal orthography or prohibition on studying meaning.

ノンデュアリティ.reason: Original defJa equates all nonduality with a monistic state while traditions differ; replace with non-separation definition and attributed distinct philosophical contexts.

note: Final whole-cloud factual audit; only initial successes with zero previous rewrites. One rewrite, then terminal drop.
